description.value:
You plant a simple, reasonable-sounding suggestion (a sentence or two) in the minds of as many as twelve creatures you choose within range that can see you and understand your words; creatures immune to being charmed are unaffected. A suggestion that would obviously harm the listener fails automatically.

Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or spend the power's duration pursuing the suggested course of action to the best of its ability; the power ends early if the task is completed sooner. You may attach a triggering condition to the suggestion (for example, giving coin to the first beggar encountered); if the condition never arises, the activity simply never happens. Should you or an ally harm an affected creature, the power ends for it immediately. Droids and constructs are unaffected.

Cast with a 7th-level slot, the duration becomes 10 days; with an 8th-level slot, 30 days; and with a 9th-level slot, a year and a day.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 6
